column1: # Words the SymSpell lists lack or undercount: contractions and chat words. Format: word<TAB>count.
# Read by Tools/build_typing_model.py. Contractions are lowercase with a straight apostrophe; the
# keyboard types a curly one when smart quotes are on and capitalises "i'm" to "I'm".
# Counting rules (computed once from the pinned bigram file, then written down here so the build
# needs no arithmetic and stays reproducible):
#   contraction  = count of its expanded pair in frequency_bigramdictionary_en_243_342.txt, for
#                  example don't = "do not", i'm = "i am". can't is "can not" plus the unigram
#                  count of "cannot". A contraction whose pair is absent would get 10000000; none
# The builder keeps max(count here, count in the SymSpell unigram list), so a chat word the list
# already ranks higher (yeah, okay, gonna, wanna) is not demoted, and the 300000 placeholders the
# list gives some contractions are replaced.
